purpose: Admin HTTP boundary for category family, subcategory, attribute, filter, tax, and styling configuration mutations.
businessRules: Only SUPER_ADMIN, CHANGE_SUBMITTER, CHANGE_REVIEWER, or CHANGE_MANAGER can access category admin endpoints.
Every mutation uses Idempotency-Key, request fingerprinting, and a coarse category configuration Redis lock.
Responses return the refreshed active category graph so admin UI can re-render from backend truth.
Admin responses are private no-store API envelopes with trace IDs.
